Usage: memoriahub date-infer [options] [command]

Infer missing capture dates from filenames (diagnose report or write via
ExifTool)

Options:
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  diagnose [options] [folder...]  Report-only: show which files have no capture
                                  date and what would be inferred
  apply [options] [folder...]     Infer AND write missing capture dates into
                                  each file via ExifTool
  help [command]                  display help for command
